headline: Vocabulary Association Chain Game for ESL Classrooms
outcomes: Students build mental vocabulary networks by linking related concepts and words
Practice retrieving and articulating word associations under gentle time pressure
Develop awareness of semantic fields, collocations, and thematic word groups
Encourage creative thinking about how words connect in meaning and usage
howItWorks: The AI generates a starting word related to your chosen topic
The first student types a word that connects meaningfully to the starting word
Each subsequent student adds a word connected to the previous one — building the chain
A student who repeats a word or can't connect breaks the chain; rounds are scored on chain length
teacherUseCases: Topic introduction to activate and map prior vocabulary knowledge
Creative warm-up that surfaces unexpected vocabulary connections
Low-stakes review that gets the whole class thinking simultaneously

faq.q: How strict is the connection requirement?
faq.a: The AI evaluates whether the connection is genuine and explainable, not just phonetic. Students must submit a word that relates in meaning, theme, or usage — not just a word that sounds similar.

faq.q: What if a student can't think of a word?
faq.a: They can pass, which ends their turn without penalty but breaks the chain streak. The next student starts a new chain from the same word.
Yes. Set the topic and the starting word will be pulled from that domain — great for focused vocabulary fields like food, travel, or business.

faq.q: Do students each need their own device?
faq.a: Yes — each student uses their own phone or tablet to type their word. The session runs in any mobile browser. No app install or student account required.

Absolute beginners may find it challenging, but A2 students with basic vocabulary participate well. Easy difficulty seeds the chain with common, concrete nouns where most learners know several associations.
Yes, free to run. Students join through a browser link — no downloads or accounts required on either side.
